verdict.rationale: Kushki documents Apple Pay payments with sandbox testing (kushki-docs-26) and a local Chilean redirect method, Webpay Plus (kushki-docs-6, kushki-docs-31, kushki-docs-32). Its marketing claims multiple payment methods through one API (kushki-docs-12), so part of the single-integration story is covered. missing for 10: Google Pay evidence, BNPL evidence, bank-transfer redirect methods beyond Webpay, documentation that wallets and local methods share one integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
